summary: AstraZeneca furnished a 6-K announcing a clinical collaboration agreement with Summit Therapeutics to evaluate Datroway (datopotamab deruxtecan), jointly developed with Daiichi Sankyo, in combination with Summit's ivonescimab across multiple tumour types, starting with a Phase III first-line triple-negative breast cancer trial in 2026. Each party contributes its medicine, shares trial costs, and retains rights to its own asset; AstraZeneca or Daiichi Sankyo will sponsor trials. No financial terms, ownership changes, or advisory roles were disclosed. AstraZeneca references a prior equity investment in Summit supporting combination collaborations. This is an ordinary pipeline collaboration, not a special situation.
